title: Pagoda Garden AC-130
description: A voxel Japanese pagoda garden seen through a circling AC-130 sensor: stabilized WHOT and warm daylight views, 25 mm cannon, 40 mm Bofors and 70 mm rockets, persistent block damage, support-driven structural collapse, debris, smoke and shockwaves. Generated and iteratively tuned by GLM-5.3 Flash via omp.
